fields.statement: A full dyadic reciprocal first moment away from the twist and a pointwise optimized local Perron shift prove the classical q1 rate for the prescribed shifted Mobius array.
fields.compatible_assumptions: RH; exact BFH first-reciprocal and Mertens inputs, Bui-Florea uniform pointwise estimate, fixedA>C, full-height norm; no short-window moment extrapolation.
fields.already_proved: Uniform twisted bound for every cutoffx>=N, low/middle/high height split, classical rate and exact q1 leading coefficient after the separately checked ratio slope.
fields.conjectural_or_unresolved: Historical priority, unrestricted optimality and effective constants. Complete recent input proofs were not independently audited end to end.
fields.next_precise_step: Compare exact prescribed-array antecedents and independently audit the recent reciprocal-first-moment dependency; propagate effective constants.
fields.potential_counterexamples: Generic envelope-only Fourier multiplier bound fails by modulation; using Proposition14 at the smaller shift would be invalid, so the proof uses Proposition13 and a new intermediate contour.
fields.tests: Two independent contour/source reconstructions plus director verification of all-x Abel eligibility and exact source regimes.
fields.significance: Explicit source-dependent classical approximation improvement relative to the quoted2010 bound; no current-best or novelty claim.
fields.difficulty: Uniform analytic contour proof using substantial declared source estimates.

fields.statement: Common-sequence consistency, exact mass and uniform pointwise caps allow the large h=1 phase projection under P/k and induced-unit-mean discrepancy budgets.
fields.already_proved: Nonnegative real and integer versions with exact mass, stated two norm budgets, common-divisor compatibility and the phase lower bound. The bounded versions have real weights in [1/2,3/2] or integer weights in {0,1,2} on J. The unit-centered real projection against W(n)=Σ_(k∈S)(c_k/k)·1_((n,k)=1)·(cos(2πn/k)−μ(k)/φ(k)) is ≫|S|√T, exceeding T log⁴T by a divergent factor.
fields.tests: Short positive convolution, rational-frequency Gram bounds, imprimitive denominator accounting and multinomial sampling. The bounded versions use the second-derivative estimate for the full modulus shell, the positive selected-frequency diagonal, and bounded rounding with a single-unit mass correction.
